create.name: Sonia Choquette
create.bio:
Sonia Choquette is an American intuitive, author and teacher who has spent more than fifty years helping people trust their inner guidance. She grew up in a large family where her mother read for others, gave her own first readings at the age of twelve, studied for over a decade with two teachers of intuition, and later earned a doctorate in metaphysics. Her view is that intuition is an ordinary human sense that anyone can train, and her teaching keeps it practical, lively and often funny.

She has written more than thirty books, among them Trust Your Vibes, Ask Your Guides, The Psychic Pathway and Read Life Accurately, as well as oracle decks, and has spoken at events run by Hay House and many others. Through her company Inner Wisdom she offers self-paced video courses on intuition, spirit guides and children's intuition, a monthly membership called the Good Vibes Tribe with live calls alongside her daughters Sabrina and Sonia Tully, and a limited number of private readings each month. She also hosts salons of six people at her family homes in Europe and the United States, runs a professional certification for intuitive coaches, and shares weekly teaching videos and a podcast with her daughters.

books.title: Trust Your Vibes
books.author: Sonia Choquette
books.description: Her best-known guide to what she calls six-sensory living: everyday tools for noticing and acting on intuition, with exercises for each chapter.

books.title: Ask Your Guides
books.author: Sonia Choquette
books.description: An introduction to working with spirit guides, describing the kinds of helpers she believes we have and simple ways to ask them for support.

books.title: Read Life Accurately
books.author: Sonia Choquette
books.description: A book on seeing situations and people clearly by combining intuition with honest observation, so that choices come from what is really happening.

books.title: 21 Days to Jump-Start Your Intuition
books.author: Sonia Choquette
books.description: A three-week programme of short daily practices meant to wake up and strengthen intuition step by step.

books.title: Soul Lessons and Soul Purpose
books.author: Sonia Choquette
books.description: A channelled guide to the lessons a soul comes to learn and how they link to finding a purpose in this life.

books.title: The Psychic Pathway
books.author: Sonia Choquette
books.description: One of her earliest books: a workbook of lessons and exercises for reawakening the inner voice of the soul.

books.title: Your Heart's Desire
books.author: Sonia Choquette
books.description: Practical steps for getting clear about what you want and creating it, joining intention with intuition.

books.title: The Answer Is Simple
books.author: Sonia Choquette
books.description: A book of short teachings on loving yourself and living from your spirit in daily life.

books.title: The Intuitive Spark
books.author: Sonia Choquette
books.description: A guide for parents on recognising and supporting intuition in children and bringing it into family life.

books.title: Your 3 Best Super Powers
books.author: Sonia Choquette
books.description: An argument that meditation, imagination and intuition are natural powers everyone has, with ways to practise each.

courses.title: Trust Your Vibes (12-week online course)
courses.description: Twelve short video lessons, about fifteen minutes each, taken at a pace of one a week. The course is her starting point for noticing and trusting intuition in ordinary life.

courses.title: Ask Your Guides (online course)
courses.description: Sixteen video lessons with exercises on meeting and working with spirit guides and angels, best spread over about eight weeks.

courses.title: Read Life Accurately (online course)
courses.description: A longer course of nineteen video lessons on reading energy and situations clearly and acting on what you sense.

courses.title: Protect Your Child's Intuition (online course)
courses.description: Twelve daily video lessons of fifteen minutes for parents, starting with the parent's own awareness and moving on to nurturing a child's intuition at home.

courses.title: The Good Vibes Tribe (membership)
courses.description: A monthly online community with a live call from Sonia, further calls on purpose and creativity led by her daughters, daily check-ins, a new meditation each month and guided runs through her courses.
courses.price: $5 USD first month, then $35 USD a month

courses.title: Private Reading with Sonia
courses.description: A one-to-one call of thirty or sixty minutes in which Sonia reads intuitively on the questions you bring. Only a few appointments are released each month, with a waiting list when they are gone.

courses.title: Private Salon in Paris
courses.description: A three-day gathering for six people, held in the afternoons at her family home in Paris, combining intuitive practice, time with spirit guides and next steps for each participant. Places are by application.

courses.title: Oracle Reading Bundle
courses.description: A written reading made with her Trust Your Vibes oracle cards on a theme you choose, emailed within a few hours, plus a short audio and a beginners' mini-course on using card decks.

free_resources.title: Free Meditation Kit: Silence the Barking Dog
free_resources.description: A free download sent by email: a thirty-second reset and a channelled guided meditation for quietening the busy mind so that inner guidance can be heard.
